title.en: An Act Granting to Roman Baluyut a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat, and Power Plant in the Municipalities of Apalit, Macabebe, Masantol, San Simon, and San Luis, Province of Pampanga, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to Roman Baluyut, for a period of fifty years from the approval of this Act,
the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power system
for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within the limits of the
municipalities of Apalit, Macabebe, Masantol, San Simon, and San Luis, Province of Pampanga, Philippine
Islands. The plant shall be located in the municipality of Apalit, above mentioned.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 14, 1931.
